Federal Register/Vol. 91, No. 140/ Thursday, July 23, 2026/ Presidential Documents

46685

A. Effective with respect to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for
consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern time on August 19, 2026, subchapter III of
chapter 99 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) is modified as

follows:

1. Subdivision (a) of U.S. note 51 is modified by deleting “9903.03.13” and inserting

“9903.03.14” in lieu thereof;

Annex II

2. New subdivision (b)(3) to U.S. note 51 is inserted in numerical order:

“3, Heading 9903.03.14 applies to articles classifiable in the following provisions of the tariff

schedule:
